description: This file defines a HttpClient class that facilitates sending HTTP GET and POST requests, handling connection setup, headers, parameters, and response processing within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A utility class for sending HTTP GET and POST requests, managing request headers, parameters, SSL configurations, and handling responses within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setDebug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug output for this HttpClient instance.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the connection timeout duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: followRedirects
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic redirect following.

methods.name: setLineFeed
methods.description: Enables or disables line feeds in the response content.

methods.name: setRawStream
methods.description: Sets a raw payload stream for POST requests.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the target URL for the request.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets query or form parameters for the request.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Adds or updates a single request parameter.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets multiple request headers.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Adds or updates a single request header.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves current request headers.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current request parameters.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the request URL.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header for the request.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the current Content-Type setting.

methods.name: setStreamCharset
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for streaming data.

methods.name: getStreamCharset
methods.description: Returns the current stream charset.

methods.name: setKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables keep-alive for the connection.

methods.name: getKeepAlive
methods.description: Returns whether keep-alive is enabled.

methods.name: setClientCertificateAlias
methods.description: Sets the SSL client certificate alias.

methods.name: getClientCertificateAlias
methods.description: Gets the current SSL client certificate alias.

methods.name: setHostVerificationLevel
methods.description: Configures the server hostname verification level.

methods.name: getHostVerificationLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname verification level.

methods.name: setAllowUntrusted
methods.description: Allows trusting untrusted SSL certificates.

methods.name: getAllowUntrusted
methods.description: Returns whether untrusted SSL certificates are accepted.

methods.name: setBasicAuthInfo
methods.description: Sets basic HTTP authentication credentials.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns the response content.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with optional raw stream payload.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns an InputStream of the response.

methods.name: postStream
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST and returns an InputStream of the response.

methods.name: getResponseHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific response header.

methods.name: getResponseHeaderFieldKey
methods.description: Retrieves the header key at position n.

methods.name: getResponseHeaderField
methods.description: Retrieves the header value at position n.

methods.name: getResponseContent
methods.description: Gets the response content object.

methods.name: getResponseContentType
methods.description: Returns the Content-Type of the response.

methods.name: getResponseContentLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the response content.

methods.name: getResponseContentEncoding
methods.description: Returns the encoding of the response content.

methods.name: getResponseCode
methods.description: Gets the HTTP response status code.

methods.name: sendHttpRequest
methods.description: Handles the execution of the HTTP request based on method and processes the response.

methods.name: sendHttpRequestStream
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request and returns the InputStream of the response.

methods.name: getUrlContent
methods.description: Static method to fetch URL content as a string.

methods.name: checkHttpRequest
methods.description: Static method to check the HTTP response code for a URL.
